title: UPDATE PaymentScreen UI WITH ADDRESS SELECTION + BETTER PAYM...

messages.content:
UPDATE PaymentScreen UI WITH ADDRESS SELECTION + BETTER PAYMENT UI:

========================
1. ADD ADDRESS SECTION (TOP OF ORDER SUMMARY)
========================

- Add a new section ABOVE "Order Summary":

TITLE: "Select Delivery Address"

CASE 1: If NO address saved:
  - Show button:
    ➤ "Add Address"
  - On click:
    → Open Add Address Screen / Bottom Sheet
    → Fields:
        Name
        Phone
        Address
        City
        Pincode
    → Save to local DB / Firebase

CASE 2: If address EXISTS:
  - Show selected address card:
    Name
    Address
    Phone

  - Add:
    ➤ "Change" button

  - On click:
    → Open address list
    → Select existing OR Add new

========================
2. AUTO SAVE ADDRESS
========================

- After first successful order:
  → Save entered address to user profile
  → Auto-fill next time

========================
3. PAYMENT OPTIONS UI IMPROVEMENT
========================

- Under "Pay Online" add subtitle:
  "UPI • Card • Net Banking"

- Keep only 2 options:
  [ Pay Online ]   [ Cash on Delivery ]

========================
4. ICON IMPROVEMENT
========================

- Pay Online icon:
  → Use lightning ⚡ OR payment icon 💳

- COD icon:
  → Use cash 💵 OR hand icon 🤝

- Replace current generic icons with meaningful ones

========================
5. BUTTON UI IMPROVEMENT
========================

- Increase size of both buttons
- Add slight shadow / elevation
- Add border radius (modern look)

========================
6. VALIDATION BEFORE PAYMENT
========================

IF no address selected:
  → Show error:
    "Please select delivery address"

  → DO NOT proceed to payment

========================
7. FLOW FINAL
========================

Cart → Payment Screen

Payment Screen:
  → Select Address
  → Order Summary
  → Select Payment Method
  → Pay Button

========================
8. PAY BUTTON LOGIC
========================

IF Pay Online:
  → Open Razorpay

IF COD:
  → Place order directly

========================
9. KEEP EXISTING LOGIC SAME
========================

- GST calculation correct (18%)
- Delivery fee dynamic
- Total same everywhere

========================
FINAL RESULT:
- Clean UI
- Address system working
- Professional payment screen
- Real app feel (Swiggy level)
